misconceptions.description: Assuming the model knows current facts.
misconceptions.trigger: learner asks about this week's events and trusts the answer
misconceptions.feedback: Models learn from data up to a cutoff. Check dates and recent facts against a current source.

misconceptions.trigger: learner cites the chatbot as the source of a fact
misconceptions.feedback: A chatbot is not a source. Find and cite the original evidence.
